scope: Restored metadata-only records gain an optional canonical startup-condition digest so a retained requestId is classified as identical (ANALYSIS_JOB_REQUEST_RESTORED) or different (ANALYSIS_JOB_REQUEST_CONFLICT) startup conditions before any input read. No job resume, result restoration or re-analysis.

design.recordVersion: unchanged at schemaVersion 1; startupDigest is an additive optional field so version1 records without it still load
design.descriptor: descriptorVersion=1 plus resolved absolute input/output paths, operation, size, method, adaptive, includeFields
design.pathCaseFolding: none; resolve() normalization only, case is not unified
design.notProvenByDigest: whether a same-path input file was later modified
design.unknownOrInvalidDigest: record rejected with ANALYSIS_JOB_STORE_CORRUPT_RECORD diagnostic; unknown fields rejected
design.ordering: digest computed and restored requestId matched before any input stat/read or worker start
design.differentDigest: ANALYSIS_JOB_REQUEST_CONFLICT (explicit requestId conflict, message includes jobId)
design.limitsUnchanged: maxRecords=256, maxRecordBytes=8192, no raw paths, no project/result arrays
